question: The Indravati National Park is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indravati National Park is located in the state of **Chhattisgarh**, India.
 
• It is situated in the Bijapur district and is a part of the **Dandakaranya region**.
 
• Indravati National Park is renowned for being one of the prime habitats of the endangered species **Indian Wild Buffalo (Bubalus arnee)**.
 
• The park is named after the **Indravati River**, which flows through the area.
 
• Declared a National Park in **1981**, it later became a Tiger Reserve under the Project Tiger initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Wild Buffalo:**

 
 
• The Indian Wild Buffalo is listed as **endangered** by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
 
• Its population has been declining due to habitat loss, poaching, and interbreeding with domestic buffaloes.
 
• Indravati National Park is considered one of the last strongholds of this species.
 
 
 
• **Project Tiger:**
 
 
• Launched in **1973**, Project Tiger aims to conserve India's tiger population and its habitats.
 
• Indravati National Park was included in Project Tiger in **1983** to protect its rich biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Flora and Fauna of Indravati National Park:**
 
 
• The park is home to diverse wildlife, including species like leopards, sloth bears, sambar deer, and barking deer.
 
• It features tropical moist and dry deciduous forests, dominated by teak and sal trees.
 
 
 
• **Indravati River:**
 
 
• The Indravati River is a tributary of the **Godavari River**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in supporting the ecosystem of the national park.
